provenance.note: Ryzom garment meshes mapped to EQ (piece, variation): civil01->00, armor00->01, armor01->02, caster01->03. Applied when the .babylon is written; the raw rig does not carry it.

response.note: Per-texel material response. `r` marks skin, so a complexion multiplies there and a dye does not; `g` marks the heraldic charge; `b` marks what a dye may recolour. A layer with no mask is wholly dyeable.
